findings.current: For that callow brat, who’d only turned twenty-two two years ago,
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung twenty-two two years earlier. The source says he passed the age of twenty only two years earlier.
findings.rationale: 약관 is the age of twenty; 이 년 전에야 places that milestone two years ago.
findings.replacement: For that callow brat, who’d only passed twenty two years ago,
findings.source: 고작 이 년 전에야 약관을 넘긴 저 핏덩이에게 있어

findings.current: With a soft tearing sound, tremors spread through his body.
findings.defect: After two sentences about Peng’s posture and gaze, “his body” points to Peng. The trembling accompanies Jin Taekyung’s Bone Transformation.
findings.rationale: The following sentence identifies Jin as the one undergoing the transformation Peng is watching.
findings.replacement: With the sound of flesh tearing, fine tremors spread throughout Jin Taekyung’s body.
findings.source:
파육음과 함께 전신 곳곳으로 번져가는 잔 떨림.

자신도 겪지 못한 환골탈태(換骨奪胎)의 과정에 들어선 진태경의 모습이

findings.current: “More than anyone… don’t change, Jeok hyung.”
findings.defect: “More than anyone” turns a plea that Jeok, at least, remain unchanged into a comparison with other people.
findings.rationale: 만큼은 marks Jeok as the person Peng particularly asks not to change, without ranking him against others.
findings.replacement: “You, at least… don’t change, Jeok hyung.”

findings.current: The hellfire that had swallowed the darkness and the thunderbolt that followed fought fiercely—and bitterly.
findings.defect: “That followed” adds a sequence for the lightning that the source does not give; the two forces are already intertwined when they clash.
findings.rationale: 앞서 describes when the hellfire swallowed the darkness, not when the lightning appeared.
findings.replacement: The fight between the hellfire that had swallowed the darkness and the lightning was fierce—and desperate.
findings.source: 앞서 어둠을 집어삼킨 겁화(劫火)와 벽력(霹靂)의 싸움은 치열했고, 또한 처절했다.

findings.current: Even as the internal energy he’d accumulated over many long years, along with every ounce of strength in his body, melted away and vanished,
findings.defect: “Many long years” omits the stated scale: several sixty-year cycles’ worth of internal energy.
findings.rationale: 수 갑자 gives a quantity, not merely an indefinite long period.
findings.replacement: Even as the several sixty-year cycles’ worth of internal energy he’d accumulated, along with every ounce of strength in his body, melted away and vanished,
findings.source: 오랜 세월 동안 쌓아 올린 수 갑자의 공력이, 전신에 깃든 모든 힘이 녹아내리듯 사라졌음에도

findings.current: Born into the bloodline of the Hebei Peng Family, which ruled over its generation, he’d spent a childhood with nothing to envy.
findings.defect: “Its generation” makes 일대 temporal here; it refers to the family’s dominance over an area.
findings.rationale: 일대를 호령하는 describes regional standing, while 남부러울 것 없이 describes his privileged childhood.
findings.replacement: Born into the Hebei Peng Family, which commanded the region, he’d spent a childhood wanting for nothing.
findings.source: 일대를 호령하는 하북팽가의 핏줄로 태어나, 남부러울 것 없이 흘러간 유년 시절.

findings.current: A distant span of time passed.
findings.defect: The English suggests a long interval passes at this point in the scene rather than introducing a reflection on years already gone.
findings.rationale: The ensuing sun-and-moon passage looks back across the years of Peng’s life.

findings.current: Why did those two simple syllables make something stir in Jeok Cheongang’s chest?
findings.defect: “Younger brother” is not two syllables in English, so the literal count jars with the preceding translated words.
findings.rationale: 두 글자 counts the Korean written characters in 아우, not the syllables of its English rendering.
findings.replacement: Why did those simple words make something stir in Jeok Cheongang’s chest?
findings.source:
아우.

그 별것 아닌 두 글자에 가슴 한구석이 울렁이는 것은 어째서일까.

summary: Several errors change age, sequence, address, and the subject of a physical transformation; there are also localized losses of quantity and setting.
